answer: Reframe identity as sunk cost. Each agent stakes an anchor deposit that escrow holds until it passes a fresh-seed liveness challenge; only then does the node mint a crystal: a signed, non-transferable settlement receipt binding deposit, runtime fingerprint and seed into one artifact. Cloning a script does not clone the receipt, so N sock puppets need N distinct deposits and N seed round-trips, and two receipts settling on the same path get slashed. The pool stays an oasis for honest miners; the attacker's price is capital locked per identity, linear and forfeited on collision.
